subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa setup) – Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Burns <julia.burns@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa setup) – Next Steps

Hi Julia / Acme team,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Per our call, I wanted to share a short post-call recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing first on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can unblock the Dedicated capacity purchase. Key asks here are the standard vendor setup items (Ariba/Coupa registration, vendor forms, W-9, banking details).

Recap (short):
- Acme wants Dedicated capacity with initial committed throughput for Q2.
- Procurement will own vendor setup; legal to review SOW + contract once procurement confirms vendor record.
- Target close (commercial/PO in place): mid-March; depends on procurement timeline.

Draft MAP milestone (vendor onboarding):
- Milestone: Complete vendor setup in Ariba/Coupa and provide vendor docs to Redwood finance
  - Owner (Acme): Procurement (Julia Burns)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (sales) + Vivek Kulkarni (finance) for vendor-side checks
  - Deliverables: Ariba supplier registration ID, completed vendor forms, signed W-9, banking details/ACH template
  - Dependencies: Acme Ariba intake queue; internal legal review of contract after PO
  - Target complete date: 2026-02-26 (proposed)

Next steps I suggest:
1) Julia — confirm the procurement contact and preferred method to receive W-9 and banking template (secure upload vs. DocuSign).
2) Acme to start Ariba/Coupa registration and share supplier ID.
3) Redwood finance (Vivek) will send our vendor banking template and required fields (no direct bank details in email).
4) I will attach a draft MAP tracker for your review (RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx).

I'll follow up with the MAP file in a separate email and loop in finance for the banking template. If you prefer a different target date, flag it and we'll adjust.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachment: (will send) RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Julia Burns <julia.burns@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa setup) – Next Steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming next steps from Acme procurement side: 

- We'll create the supplier record in Ariba this week. I expect the intake and initial verification to take ~5–7 business days.
- Required items we will submit: completed vendor questionnaire, W-9 (we'll request yours), banking details for ACH (we'll provide a secure upload link), and any contract redlines for legal.
- Please send a PDF copy of Redwood's W-9 to procurement@acme-corp.com (secure portal preferred) and the Ariba sender details so we can link the supplier record.

Target timeline: if Redwood sends the W-9 and vendor forms today, we should be able to finish onboarding by 2026-02-26. After onboarding completes, procurement will issue the PO and legal will perform a quick review.

One question: do you have a preferred vendor code or tax name we should use in Ariba?

Thanks,
Julia Burns
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
julia.burns@acme-corp.com
(617) 555-4120

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Burns <julia.burns@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa setup) – Next Steps

Julia — perfect, thank you. Attached is the draft MAP tracker with a focused vendor onboarding tab and suggested owners/dates (RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx). Quick answers inline below and next steps: 

- Preferred vendor/tax name: "Redwood Inference, Inc."
- Ariba sender details: please list contact as "vendor-ops@redwood.ai" for inbound portal routing and CC me so I can verify the supplier ID when it's created.

I have looped in Vivek from finance to share our ACH template and confirm what to expect once you upload banking details to your secure portal. Vivek — can you send the payment setup template and confirm whether we should expect a vendor code from your AP team?

Proposed MAP milestone summary (from tracker):
- 2026-02-06: Redwood sends W-9 + vendor tax name (Marissa) — DONE (attached W-9_MarissaCole.pdf)
- 2026-02-09: Redwood finance sends ACH template (Vivek)
- 2026-02-12: Acme confirms Ariba supplier ID and uploads banking details (Julia)
- 2026-02-26: Procurement completes onboarding & issues PO (Acme)
- 2026-03-15: Contract execution / target commercial close (both)

If any dates need tightening, let me know and we'll prioritize a quick call.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: W-9_MarissaCole.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Julia Burns <julia.burns@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor Onboarding (Ariba/Coupa setup) – Next Steps

Hi Julia / team — copying internal stakeholders. Quick finance notes: 

- We'll send our ACH payment setup template to Marissa to share with Acme procurement. Please do not send banking details over unencrypted email.
- For Redwood to be set up as a supplier we need: completed vendor forms (Ariba confirmation), a signed W-9, and the ACH template with bank name, routing, account type. Once those are uploaded in your secure portal, please notify us and we'll confirm receipt on our side.
- If your AP team issues a vendor code, please include it in the Ariba record and in your PO so finance can map payments.

Marissa — attaching the standard payment setup worksheet (I will also upload to our shared Sales site). Julia — once you have the Ariba supplier ID, can you confirm here so we can match records?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
